tasks.title: Add the MongoDB service to docker-compose
tasks.description: Add a mongo service using mongo:7-alpine with port 27017, a healthcheck running mongosh --eval "db.adminCommand('ping')", and the named volume riaya_mongodata. Leave the postgres and redis services byte-identical.

tasks.title: Create the idempotent env bootstrap script
tasks.description: Create scripts/setup-env.mjs: for server, web and backoffice, copy .env.example to .env only when .env is absent, print one line per package (created, skipped, missing example) and exit 0 even when a later package has no example.

tasks.title: Wire the bootstrap into the root package scripts
tasks.description: Add "setup": "node scripts/setup-env.mjs" to the root package.json scripts without renaming or reordering the existing entries.

tasks.title: Document the MongoDB key and confirm ignore rules
tasks.description: Add the MongoDB connection key to server/.env.example beside REDIS_URL with a local default and no real credential; confirm .gitignore still ignores .env while .env.example remains tracked.

tasks.title: Rewrite the README quick start and troubleshooting
tasks.description: Document prerequisites (Node 20, pnpm 10, Docker running), pnpm install, pnpm setup, docker compose up -d, pnpm dev and the three ports; add troubleshooting for ports 5432/6379/27017 and for an existing .env that needs MONGO_URL added by hand.

tasks.title: Record the manual evidence for the environment guarantees
tasks.description: Run pnpm setup twice and confirm the second run reports skipped for all three packages and changes nothing; bring the stack up and confirm all three services are healthy; time a fresh-clone run for NFR-001 and record the result in the implementation report.

resolution.reason: The idempotency half is verified (run 1: 2 created / 1 skipped; run 2: 0 created / 3 skipped). The Docker-dependent half - compose health for the three services and the timed fresh-clone run for NFR-001 - cannot be executed because no Docker daemon is reachable on this host.

tasks.title: Run the verification gates
tasks.description: Run pnpm format:check, pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, sdrive verify monorepo-and-local-environment and node .sdrive/scripts/validate-governance.js.
